banner.body: Strategy execution now targets this platform's paper account (sim). This page shows the Binance Testnet history from before the switch; no new records are produced, so differences from the Strategy accounts page are expected. For the latest strategy trades see

empty.title: No testnet data
empty.hint: Configure the binance-testnet api-key/secret-key in application.yml and enable strategy.execution.enabled; data appears once orders are filled

grid.title: Daily trade grid
grid.hint: Tap a cell for that day's fills

fill.title: fill reconciliation
fill.hint: Reality check on the backtest's touch=fill assumption
fill.note: Fill rate = the share of entry orders resting at the retracement level that actually get filled on a pullback. The backtest assumes "touch = fill (100%)", while a live GTX maker order still has to wait in the queue — the closer this fill rate is to the backtest assumption, the more trustworthy the backtest; the wider the gap, the more optimistic it is.

manual.title: API self-check · Manual trading
manual.subtitle: Admin only · Direct to testnet
manual.note: Quantity is in coin-denominated contracts (e.g. BTC 0.002). Configure the binance-testnet api-key/secret-key in application.yml first; for manual testing, turn automatic execution off (strategy.execution.enabled=false) so the two state machines do not conflict.
